title: Coltrane and early Miles Davis versus later work
summary: McRae says the early Coltrane and Miles sold best, and later experimental records lost the general public, citing his work at Record Shack.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
